proposals.before: Wang Rong, whose style name was Yuanchang, came from Langya in Linyi.
proposals.after: Wang Rong, whose style name was Yuanchang, was a native of Linyi in Langya.
proposals.reason: Chinese 琅邪臨沂人 means a native of Linyi in Langya commandery; idiomatic reverses the place hierarchy.

proposals.before: Now those who deliberate sometimes worry about the Western Xia; your subject privately thinks it is not so.
proposals.after: Now those who deliberate sometimes take the western Xia frontier as their concern; your subject privately thinks it is not so.
proposals.reason: 西夏 here is the western Xia/frontier region in a Southern Qi military context, not the later Tangut Western Xia state.

proposals.before: When the barbarians stirred, the Prince of Jingling Xiao Ziliang recruited men at the Eastern Mansion and appointed Rong General Who Pacifies the North and Army Commander.
proposals.after: When the barbarians stirred, the Prince of Jingling recruited men at the Eastern Mansion and appointed Rong General Who Pacifies the North and Army Commander.
proposals.reason: Chinese has only 竟陵王; literal invents the personal name Xiao Ziliang not present in this unit.

proposals.before: Chief Aide Wang Xiuzhi, thinking the young Tiao was too intimate with the prince, secretly reported it to the throne.
proposals.after: Chief Aide Wang Xiuzhi, because Tiao was young and stirred influence, secretly reported it to the throne.
proposals.reason: Chinese 年少相動 concerns youth and agitation/influence; idiomatic over-specifies improper intimacy not required by the wording.

proposals.before: When Duke Huan of Qi meant to attack Ju, Guo Ya read his hidden intent; when the Wei empress meant to remove Han, Xu Dezhi plumbed her deeper meaning.
proposals.after: When Duke Huan of Qi meant to attack Ju, Guo Ya read his hidden intent; when the Wei empress meant to remove Han, Dezhi (Yang Xiu) plumbed her deeper meaning.
proposals.reason: Chinese 德祖 is Yang Xiu's courtesy name; idiomatic Xu Dezhi invents an incorrect surname Xu.

proposals.before: A few days later Yaoguang had Tiao additionally manage Court of the Imperial Clan affairs; fearing entanglement, Tiao reported Si's plot to Zuo Xingsheng, who did not dare speak.
proposals.after: A few days later Yaoguang had Tiao additionally manage the affairs of the Commandant of Guards; fearing entanglement, Tiao reported Shi and the others' plot to Zuo Xingsheng, who did not dare speak.
proposals.reason: 衞尉 is the Commandant of Guards / Court of Palace Guards, not the Court of the Imperial Clan (宗正); 祏等謀 is Shi and the others' plot.

proposals.before: A few days later Yaoguang had Tiao additionally manage Court of the Imperial Clan affairs; Tiao feared being drawn in and at once reported Si and the others' plot to Zuo Xingsheng, who did not dare speak out.
proposals.after: A few days later Yaoguang had Tiao additionally manage the affairs of the Commandant of Guards; Tiao feared being drawn in and at once reported Shi and the others' plot to Zuo Xingsheng, who did not dare speak out.
proposals.reason: 衞尉 means Commandant of Guards, not Imperial Clan; keep 祏等 as Shi and the others.

proposals.before: When Tiao first reported Wang Jingze, Jingze's daughter was Tiao's wife and constantly carried a knife wishing to avenge Tiao; Tiao did not dare meet her.
proposals.after: When Tiao first reported Wang Jingze, Jingze's daughter was Tiao's wife and constantly carried a knife wishing to take revenge on Tiao; Tiao did not dare meet her.
proposals.reason: 報朓 means to take revenge on Tiao, not to avenge Tiao; the idiomatic already has the correct sense.

decisions.reason: 琅邪臨沂人 names Linyi under Langya commandery; 'Langya in Linyi' reverses that hierarchy, and 'native of Linyi in Langya' restores it.
In this Southern Qi memorial 西夏 is the western Xia/frontier concern, not the later Tangut Western Xia; the proposed literal removes that anachronistic state reading.

decisions.after: When the barbarians stirred, the Prince of Jingling Ziliang recruited men at the Eastern Mansion and appointed Rong General Who Pacifies the North and Army Commander.
decisions.reason: s0142 has 竟陵王子良, so Ziliang is present; only the surname Xiao is invented. Dropping both names over-corrects.

decisions.after: Chief Aide Wang Xiuzhi, because Tiao was young and was exerting influence, secretly reported it to the throne.
decisions.reason: 年少相動 marks youth and agitation/influence, so 'too intimate' over-specifies; the proposal's 'stirred influence' is awkward and needs clearer English.
The unit has only 德祖, Yang Xiu's courtesy name; 'Xu Dezhi' invents a false surname Xu, and Dezhi (Yang Xiu) restores the correct identification.
衞尉 is the Commandant of Guards, not the Court of the Imperial Clan, and 祏等謀 is Shi and the others' plot, not 'Si's plot' alone.
Same unit errors in the literal: 衞尉 is Commandant of Guards, and 祏 is Shi, with 等 marking 'and the others'.
欲報朓 means she wished to take revenge on Tiao; 'avenge Tiao' reverses the patient of 報.

claimRetractions.reason: Accepting r0005 shows 'Xu Dezhi' was created only by the bad idiomatic; s0093 has 德祖 and supports no Xu surname or Xu Dezhi alias.

claimRevisions.reason: Accepting r0006 restores 祏 as Shi; the English alternate Si was a mistransliteration from the bad translation.
